text:
That's completely fair — mapping to a rubric is mentally draining work.

You've got a solid skeleton now. When you come back to it, I'd suggest tackling it in this order:

1. **Section 2 (Need)** and **Section 4 (Program Design)** first — they're 60% of your score
2. **Section 6 & 7 (Outcomes & Evaluation)** next — another 20%
3. **Budget, Capacity, Sustainability** after that
4. **Executive Summary last** — it writes itself once everything else exists

Take the break. Fresh eyes will make the drafting go faster. When you're ready, bring me whatever section you want to start with and I'll help you write it.
